content: Nawu Esau Benbornang Dja Mak Nawu Benkebmawahmeng.
Kuhni wanjh kabenyolyolme Esau dja nawu benbornang dja nawu benkebmawahmeng. (Esau nungka mak ngeyyoy Edom.)

Esau benbenemey ngalbibininjkobeng kore Canaanbeh daluk, ngalkudji Adah ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuye Elon nawu Nahit bininj, dja ngalbuyika Oholibamah ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuye Anah, nawu nungan nuyeni kornkumo wanjh Zibeon ngalbu ngeyyoy Hiv,
dja mak Esau bimey Basemath ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuyeni Ishmael dja ngaleng benedanginj Nebaioth.
Adah bimarneyawmey Esau Eliphaz. Basemath biyawmey Reuel.
Dja Oholibamah benyawmey Jeush, Jalam, dja Korah. Birrimekbe wanjh bebeywurd nuye Esau nawu birrimarnedanginj kore kubolkwarlah Canaan.

Esau benkang ngalbibininjkobeng nuye dja bebeywurd ngalbebeywurd dja bininj nuye rowk nawu birridjarrkni, dja mak benkang mayh nuye rowk, dja yehyeng rowk nuye nawu mangi kore Canaan, dja nungka wam kore kubolkwarlah djarrehkah kore benedanginj nawu Jacob.

Nawu bedda benebebbehkarrmi wanjh nawern duninjh, wanjh kunu minj benedjarrkniwirrinj munguyh, dja kore kubolkwarlah kore benedjalwohningini minj manme manwern yuwirrinj, dja mayh berrewoneng nawern duninjh.
Wanjh kunmekbekenh kunu Esau nawu mak ngeyyoy Edom, nungka bolkmarnbom ni kore kurruluhdulum ngarre Seir.
Kuhni kabenyolyolme Esau dja nawu Esau benbornang dja benkebmawahmeng. Esau wanjh nungka mawah bedberre bininj nawu birringeyyoy Edom, nawu birrini kore kurruluhdulum ngarre kunred Seir.

Kuhni birringeyyoy Esau nuye bebeywurd dja Mawah nuye. Kaluk benbenebornang Eliphaz nawu nayaw ngarre Adah ngalbu Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng, dja Reuel nawu nayaw ngarre Basemath ngalbu Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng.
Dja nawu Eliphaz nunganwali bebeywurd nuye wanjh Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam dja Kenaz.

Dja namekbe Eliphaz nawu Esau bibornang nungka biwohmey ngalbuyika daluk ngalbu ngeyyoy Timna, ngaleng wanjh bimarneyawmey Amalek. Birrimekbe bininj rowk wanjh Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng Adah benkebmakkahmeng.
Dja nawu Reuel benbornang wanjh Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, dja Mizzah. Birrimekbe wanjh Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng Basemath benkebmakkahmeng.
Dja nayayaw ngarre Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng Oholibamah, ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuye Anah nawu Zibeon kornkumo nuyeni, wanjh nayayaw ngarre nawu bimarneyawmey Esau wanjh Jeush, Jalam, dja Korah.
Nanih wanjh nawu birriwohrnani kore Esau benkebmawahmeng. Bebeywurd nuye Eliphaz nawu nadjdjaman nuye Esau, wanjh nawu birriwohrnani kaluk Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz.
Korah, Gatam, dja Amalek. Birrimekbe wanjh bedda nawu birriwohrnani nawu Eliphaz benkebmawahmeng kore kubolkwarlah Edom, bedda wanjh Adah benkebmakkahmeng.

Dja bebeywurd nuye Reuel nawu Esau bibornang, wanjh bedda nawu birriwohrnani kaluk Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, dja Mizzah. Bedda wanjh birrimekbe nawu birriwohrnani, nawu Reuel benkebmawahmeng kore Edom, bedda wanjh Basemath benkebmakkahmeng, ngalbu Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng.

Dja nayayaw ngarre Oholibamah ngalbu Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng, bedda wanjh nawu birriwohrnani kaluk Jeush, Jalam, dja Korah. Bedda wanjh birrimekbe nawu birriwohrnani nawu Esau nuye ngalbininjkobeng Oholibamah benyawmey, ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuyeni Anah.
Bedda wanjh birrimekbe bebeywurd nuye Esau nawu mak ngeyyoy Edom, dja nawu bindimarnewohrnani birribuyika bedberre bininj.
Nawu Seir Benbornang Dja Benkebmawahmeng.

Bininj nawu birringeyyoy Hor, wanjh birriyingkihni kumekbe kubolkwarlah. Nanih wanjh bebeywurd dja mawahmawah nuye Seir nawu birrimekbe nawu Hor birringeyyoy. Nawu benbornang wanjh Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer, dja Dishan. Bedda nawu bebeywurd nuye Seir kore Edom nawu bindimarnewohrnani kore nawu birringeyyoy Hor.
Lotan nuye bebeywurd wanjh namud bedberre ngeyyoy Hori dja mak Heman. Dja Timna ngaleng benedanginj Lotan.
Shobal nuye bebeywurd wanjh Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, dja Onam dja nawu bindikebmawahmeng.
Zibeon nuye bebeywurd wanjh Aiah dja Anah. Nanih wanjh namekbe Anah nawu bongalkeng kore kubolkdarleh bu bennahnani donkey nuye Zibeon nawu kornkumo nuye.
Anah benbenebornang Dishon dja Oholibamah ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuye Anah.
Dishon nuye bebeywurd wanjh Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, dja Keran.
Ezer nuye bebeywurd wanjh Bilhah, Zaavan, dja Akan.
Dishan nuye bebeywurd wanjh Uz dja Aran.
Bedda wanjh birrimekbe nawu bindimarnewohrnani bininj nawu birringeyyoy Hor. Kaluk birriwohrnani Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer, dja Dishan. Bedda wanjh bindibebbehmarnewohrnani nawu birringeyyoy Hor kore birribebbehmud kore kubolkwarlah Seir.
Kunkareni Nawu Kings Birriwohrnani Kore Kunred Edom.
Nanih kabirringeydi king nawu birriwohrnani kore kubolkwarlah Edom, bu minj Israel birribangmekarrmeninj king benmarnewohrnayi.
Bela nawu beywurd nuye Beor, nungka yimerranj king wohrnani kore Edom. Kubolkkimuk nuye bolkngeyyoy Dinhabah.
Bu Bela doweng, wanjh Jobab nawu beywurd nuye Zerah nawu nakang Bozrah, nunganwali wanjh yimerranj king.
Bu Jobab doweng, Husham nawu nakang kubolkwarlah bedberre nawu Teman benkebmawahmeng, nunganwali yimerranj king.
Bu Husham doweng, wanjh Hadad nawu beywurd nuye Bedad, nawu bibom Midian kore kubolkwarlah Moab, nunganwali yimerranj king. Dja kubolkkimuk nuye bolkngeyyoy Avith.
Bu Hadad doweng, Samlah nawu nakang Masrekah, nunganwali yimerranj king.
Bu Samlah doweng, Shaul nawu nakang Rehoboth kore mankabo, nunganwali yimerranj king.
Bu Shaul doweng Baal Hanan nawu beywurd nuye Acbor, nunganwali yimerranj king.

Bu Baal Hanan nawu beywurd nuye Acbor doweng, Hadad nunganwali yimerranj king. Kubolkkimuk nuye bolkngeyyoy Pau, dja ngalbininjkobeng nuye ngeyyoy Mehetabel ngalyaw ngarre Matred, ngalbu ngalbeywurd nuye Mezahab.
Nanih wanjh birringeyyoy nawu birriwohrnani nawu Esau benkebmawahmeng, kaluk nawu birriyawmud duninjh birribolkngeykenkani kunred bedberre. Kaluk Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

Magdiel dja Iram. Bedda wanjh birrimekbe nawu birriwohrnani kore Edom. Kunred kore birrini nawu birriyawmud duninjh, wanjh birribolkngeykenkani. Kuhni wanjh biyolyolmeng Esau nawu benkebmawahmeng bininj nawu birringeyyoy Edom.
